name: Shortest Vector Problem
description: Find a shortest nonzero lattice vector.

name: Closest Vector Problem
description: Find the lattice point closest to a target.

name: Short Integer Solution
description: Find a short nonzero modular relation.

name: Learning With Errors
description: Recover or distinguish a noisy linear system.

name: Decoding random binary codes
description: Decode a random binary linear code at a specified rate and error weight.

name: Unbalanced Oil and Vinegar
description: Key recovery and forgery for UOV systems.

name: Discrete Gaussian Sampling
description: Sample lattice vectors according to a discrete Gaussian.

name: Bounded Distance Decoding
description: Decode a target promised to be close to a lattice, with its radius and preprocessing model fixed.

name: Multivariate quadratic equations
description: Solve a system of m quadratic equations in n variables over a specified finite field.

name: MinRank
description: Find a low-rank linear combination of given matrices; dimensions, rank and field must be specified.

name: Supersingular isogeny search
description: Construct an explicit isogeny between two supersingular elliptic curves.

name: Ordinary isogeny search
description: Construct an isogeny between ordinary curves with the same endomorphism ring.

name: SIDH key recovery
description: Recover a secret isogeny using a SIDH public key, including its auxiliary torsion-point images.

name: CM class-group action inversion
description: Invert the commutative ideal-class-group action, including CRS and CSIDH settings.

name: Decoding random q-ary codes
description: Hamming-metric syndrome decoding over a specified finite field. Alphabet, rate, error weight and cost unit must be fixed.

name: Rank syndrome decoding
description: Syndrome decoding in the rank metric over F_(q^m); n, m, k and rank weight are separate parameters.

name: Decoding binary Goppa codes
description: Recover an error from a public scrambled binary-Goppa parity-check matrix and syndrome, without the private decoding trapdoor.

name: Goppa-code key recovery
description: Recover equivalent hidden support and Goppa polynomial from the public code. This is distinct from decoding a single ciphertext.

name: Integer factorization
description: Find the prime factorization of a composite integer N; distinguish input length log N from the integer N itself.

name: Finding small prime factors
description: Find a prime divisor p of an integer N; running time can depend on p independently of the bitlength of N.

name: Factoring RSA moduli
description: Factor balanced semiprimes without supplied structure or partial key information. Asymptotic bounds are separate from concrete challenge factorizations.

name: Generic-group discrete logarithms
description: Recover an exponent in a cyclic group from group operations; generic algorithms do not exploit a field or curve representation.

name: Finite-field discrete logarithms
description: Compute discrete logarithms in multiplicative groups of finite fields, separating prime fields, characteristic growth and extension structure.

name: Elliptic-curve discrete logarithms
description: Compute discrete logarithms in elliptic-curve groups; distinguish ordinary cryptographic curves from anomalous or other exceptional families.

name: Learning Parity with Noise
description: Recover a binary secret from uniformly random binary linear equations corrupted by independent Bernoulli noise.
